name: call_interp2_range_on_scalar_output_rejected
source:
{ Names are case-insensitive, so the scalar output z resolves to the shape of
  the grid Z and becomes a range. A range is only legal on an assignment LHS or
  as a function argument, so the document is refused. }
xs = [0, 1]
ys = [0, 1]
Z = [0, 1; 2, 3]
CALL Interp2(xs[1:2], ys[1:2], Z, 1, 1 : z)

error.message: Array range 'z[...]' is only allowed on the LHS of assignments or as function arguments.
